themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 4 THIS WEEK—a 967% jump from the 8-week baseline of 0.4 per week—suggesting a sudden, coordinated campaign or enforcement gap in Queens Village/Cambria Heights.
evidence: 4 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (967% increase)
Z-score of 7.49 indicates statistically extreme deviation from baseline
Spike emerged abruptly this week with no prior escalation signal last 2 weeks
reporting_angles: Canvas the district to document what's being posted and where; determine if coordinated or ad-hoc
Interview DSNY or local precinct about enforcement capacity and whether they've been alerted to a pattern

themes_detail.label: Rodent Infestation Surge
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints jumped to 9 LAST WEEK—a 620% spike from the 8-week average of 1.2 per week—signaling a potential pest control or sanitation breakdown in the neighborhood.
evidence: 9 rodent complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (620% increase)
Z-score of 7.11 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
No prior warning signs in preceding weeks; appeared abruptly
reporting_angles: Interview residents in affected blocks to identify common factors (construction, new food source, waste management failure)
Contact DOHMH and Pest Control to determine if they've fielded complaints and what mitigation measures are planned

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage & Environmental Concern
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints reached 4 LAST WEEK—a 357% jump from the 0.9 weekly baseline—suggesting organized or escalating unauthorized tree removal or damage in the district.
evidence: 4 illegal tree damage complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (357% increase)
Z-score of 5.21 reflects significant deviation from baseline
Aligns with recurring community board budget request for 'better park maintenance' and park renovations—suggests underlying environmental neglect
reporting_angles: Identify which blocks/parks are seeing the most damage; interview residents and Parks Dept. on enforcement
Investigate whether this correlates with the 247-56 90th Ave rezoning project or other development activity in the district

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs & Safety Risk
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints spiked to 5 LAST WEEK—a 567% increase from the 0.8 weekly average—indicating a public safety and animal control concern emerging in the neighborhood.
evidence: 5 unleashed dog complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (567% increase)
Z-score of 4.39 reflects statistically significant spike
No prior escalation; emerged suddenly last week
reporting_angles: Interview residents about specific locations/times when unleashed dogs are encountered; assess any injuries or incidents
Contact NYPD Animal Care & Control to determine if they've been alerted and what their enforcement plan is

themes_detail.label: Asbestos Exposure Risk
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints hit 3 TWO WEEKS AGO—a 700% spike from the 0.4 weekly baseline—potentially indicating unsafe building conditions or construction disturbance in the district.
evidence: 3 asbestos complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% increase)
Z-score of 5.42 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
642 building permits filed in last 90 days (434 alterations); potential correlation with renovation-related asbestos exposure
reporting_angles: Cross-reference asbestos complaints with DOB permit data to identify which buildings or projects triggered exposure reports
Interview DOHMH and NYC Buildings Department on enforcement and whether construction sites are following asbestos abatement protocols
